content:
In connection with a special functions project I need to convert (single variable) polynomial representations between a monomial basis and an ascending factorial basis. The conversion is a linear operation involving a unit triangular matrix constructed from Stirling numbers. The Stirling numbers are in Mathlib in Mathlib.Combinatorics.Enumerative.Stirling and the algebra of the ascending factorials is in Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Pochhammer. However, I did not find the linear algebra of the transformation.
So I constructed a package PochhammerTransform to deal with those (forward and backward) transformations and prove basic properties.
Some of this might be a useful addition to either the Stirling number or the Pochhammer files already in Mathlib, or maybe the entire package could be considered as a standalone file in Mathlib.
I have not yet submitted it for review and I would welcome comments.
The package is in my public GitHub space at https://github.com/bjbraams/lean-codes/ and more precisely the package is in https://github.com/bjbraams/lean-codes/blob/main/Pochhammer/PochhammerTransform.lean.
The outer design of the package is mine, but I relied extensively on interaction with LLM. All the proofs were supplied by ChatGPT 5.6.
Comments on the package (with a view towards possible inclusion in Mathlib) will be appreciated.
